notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Commas to combination
[*] Changed Combination Text from Red to Yellow on Training
[*] Added a Thank You for Linkan
[*] Added More Random Messages
[*] Internal Changes. Note: Boring, This Only Excites The Developer (and not much)
[*] Enter Button Can Submit a Guess Again
[*] Fixed Errors and Typos in Achievements
[*] Achievements for 'uncertainty' and for beating all training difficulties fixed
[*] Removed Herobrine
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] added some messages to the main menu (under the title)
[*] made the guess text yellow so it's easier to read
[*] removed bold text and set it regular weight from status HUD, so score and max do not wrap to the next line
[*] there was a bug adding extra digits to your guess when using enter on the numpad, it is now fixed
[*] found and fixed a bug where you could use the numpad during the dialouge portion of the tutorial
[*] fixed text wrapping on the game over menu
[*] removed useless text from game over on tutorial win
[*] added colored states to buttons
[*] removed herobrine
[/list]
